pages.text: $(italic)Late descendants of the Blaze, Blazeborn walk through fire and lava unscathed.$()$(br2)$(bold)Origin Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Fire Immunity$() — $(item)Immune to fire and lava damage$(). Walk through lava freely.$(br2)$(bold)Nether Affinity$() — $(item)+10% damage, -10% damage taken in the Nether$(). After your first Nether visit, this doubles and applies everywhere.$(br2)$(bold)Hotblooded$() — $(item)Immune to poison$(). Your blazing blood burns up venoms.$(br2)$(bold)Water Discomfort$() — $(warn)Contact with water slows you and saps your strength.$()$(br2)$(bold)Cold Sensitive$() — $(warn)Snowballs deal damage to you.$()
